title: Halcyon
text: Survey note. For a year the Choir's broadcast has carried one bearing, over and over, and I was sure it pointed at Halcyon's rings. I had a whole theory. I've looked at the rings properly now: ice, dust, nothing. It was never pointing past Halcyon. It was pointing at Vess. At you.
tags: act 2, survey, halcyon, choir, red herring
notes: STORY.md §13: Halcyon's rings hide nothing; a red herring the Choir points at.
